help.whatsappText: Hello, I need help with SkillPass.

accept.q: How do I take a new job?
accept.a: When a green card appears, tap See job, then tap the big Accept button.

finish.q: How do I finish a job?
finish.a: Open the job and tap the big button each step: On the way, Start work, Work done.

payment.a: The customer pays you directly in cash or mobile money. SkillPass takes no money.

trust.q: How does my trust score grow?
trust.a: Finish jobs, come on time, answer quickly, and get good reviews.

verify.q: How do I get the verified badge?
verify.a: Open My documents and send a clear photo of both sides of your NID.
